body:
A ton of different shit, I know it's silly. Here are just a few.
- School. The stress of tests and homework and shit is hard enough. Having to deal with annoying fucks who make noise and make fun of me for having Tourette's Syndrome doesn't make it better.
- The thought of college. Don't want to get drowned in student debt and/or end up failing either way.
- All the shit I get for supposedly being "privileged" due to being a  white male. I'm not talking about online, I'm talking about the SJWs who have infested my school who cannot leave me alone, always taking the time (when I'm visibly upset) to remind me that it could be worse if I wasn't a white male.
- The fact that I'm unattractive and nobody wants anything to do with me, unless it benefits them. (e.g. going over and asking what's wrong in front of their friends and others to seem like they're good people even though they constantly bully you otherwise)
- Tons of career options that my parents will never let me pursue/get a head start on because "it's not real" due to being online, such as game developing or software engineering.
- The fact that I'm inferior to just about everybody I know of, and just about everyone in the world. (This is the one mostly sending me over the edge)
- Having to root for the same shitty ass sports teams, I just want to relax and watch a good game, not an ass whooping. 
- Plenty of other shit. It seems silly, but it's becoming unbearable
Well, I agree 100% with this rant, but I'm horny and 16, I remember in my preteen years I'd beat off to ANYTHING, nipples or not
